description: This Java class 'SerialIoStream' implements the 'IoStream' interface to manage serial port communication using the jssc.SerialPort library. It provides methods to open, close, write to, purge, and set input listeners on a serial port, encapsulating serial port operations with logging and exception handling.

classes.name: SerialIoStream
classes.description: A class that manages serial port communication, implementing methods to write, close, purge, and listen to serial data.

methods.name: SerialIoStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the serial port and logger.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the serial port and logs the action.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes byte data to the serial port.

methods.name: setInputListener
methods.description: Sets a data listener for incoming serial data.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Returns whether the serial port has been closed.
